description: This file is a shell script that orchestrates automated tests for a Git-P4 integration tool. It includes sequences to initialize repositories, perform submits, simulate various commit types (add, modify, delete, copy, rename), handle shelved changes, and create changes with detailed descriptions including jobs and other metadata. The script utilizes external P4 commands, Git commands, and shell functions to validate behavior across different scenarios.

methods.name: make_job
methods.description: Creates a new Perforce job with a specified name and description by editing the job specification template.

methods.name: last_shelve
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent shelved change list number from Perforce.

methods.name: make_shelved_cl
methods.description: Creates a new shelved changelist with a specified description and returns its change number.
